description: This Go source file defines a helper function 'mapBasedSelectorForObject' that extracts map-based selectors from various Kubernetes objects, such as Pods, Services, Deployments, and ReplicaSets, by inspecting their labels and selectors. It also includes a utility 'MakeLabels' to format label maps into string representations.

methods.name: mapBasedSelectorForObject
methods.description: Returns the map-based selector string for a given Kubernetes runtime object, handling various object types and their label/selector fields.

methods.name: MakeLabels
methods.description: Converts a map of labels into a comma-separated string of key=value pairs.
